# The Clear Stack

> AI consolidation consulting for mid-market companies (50–500 employees). We audit AI and SaaS stacks, eliminate redundant tools, and build Make.com automation that connects the rest. Engagements start with a $1,500 Stack Audit, credited in full toward implementation. Based in Santa Barbara, California, US.

## Services

- [What We Do](https://theclearstack.com/): The Clear Stack Audit ($1,500, two weeks, credited toward implementation) and done-for-you implementation ($10K–$25K, 90-day delivery). Retainers available for ongoing stack management. Self-serve Playbook PDF ($49).
- [The 4C Framework](https://theclearstack.com/method): Our methodology — Catalog, Consolidate, Connect, Coach. Includes a stack-savings calculator.
- [Use Cases](https://theclearstack.com/usecases): Engagements for professional services, financial services, healthcare operations, manufacturing & logistics, and technology companies.
- [Contact](https://theclearstack.com/contact): Book a free 30-minute intro call — no commitment.

## Lab (free tools)

- [Stack Detector](https://theclearstack.com/lab/stack-detector): Enter a company domain and detect the SaaS and AI tools running on it, with evidence.
- [Stack Analyzer](https://theclearstack.com/lab/stack-analyzer): List the software you pay for and get an instant overlap and consolidation report.
- [Marketing Dashboard](https://theclearstack.com/lab/marketing-dashboard): Free marketing asset generator — positioning line, social posts, SEO & AEO copy. Data stays in the user's browser.
- [Lab index](https://theclearstack.com/lab/): All free tools and experiments.
